name: Fibonacci
contribution: An Italian mathematician from the Republic of Pisa, considered to be "the most talented Western mathematician of the Middle Ages".
legacy: In 1202, he completed the Liber Abaci, which popularized Hindu–Arabic numerals in Europe.

checks.lead: Leonardo Bonacci, also Leonardo da Pisa (c. 1170 – c. 1240-50), commonly known as Fibonacci, was an Italian mathematician from the Republic of Pisa, considered to be "the most talented Western mathematician of the Middle Ages".
